meta.title: Astryx Studio
meta.description: Build pages with Meta's Astryx design system: the agent picks a page template, adapts it, and every write is checked for syntax, lint and types. A live preview tab the agent can screenshot at any width, and a template gallery searchable in Chinese, sit in the right sidebar.
